description: Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada prepared a dataset of daily discharge observations for the La Salle River near Elie, Manitoba, at Water Survey of Canada station 05OG008. The deposit spans 1990–2013 and was assembled for hydrological and water-quality modelling in the Red-Assiniboine project. It is derived from the catalogued HYDAT archive, with periods judged uncertain because of flooding or backwater conditions flagged and removed. The processed CSV and bilingual HTML data dictionaries are free under the Open Government Licence - Canada. Together with the companion hourly weather inputs, these data can calibrate catchment runoff simulations supporting flood-defence and irrigation studies. This is a documented processed product, not another copy of the entire national archive. Its removal of uncertain high-flow periods creates a selection limitation for flood-peak evaluation, while daily averaging cannot resolve subdaily hydrograph timing.
